interface_mismatches: Current main does not contain the Fleet-owned campaign implementation, runner, interface manifest, or the twelve-module runtime closure named by this source contract. The interface manifest has claim_modality asserted_interface_locator and effect_authority NoEffectAuthority. Exact hashes establish byte identity and track authority, not independent semantic proof or permission to execute those bytes; only separately admitted runtime call sites may use the guarded locator after validation.

A distinct retirement transaction binds the failed-attempt chain, proves an authority-quiet host, archives exact bytes, survives interruption, and only then frees singleton paths for a separately admitted replacement release.
